_: The herald (news_chips.gd; Theme Hospital's announcer, Stronghold's scribe): the notices stack quietly in the bottom-left corner (Anno's and Total War's notification stack), and the plain refusals get a dry voice. on: the voice's switch (or --herald=on). stack: most, the notices shown at once (the oldest goes); seconds, how long each stays; width, the stack's width in points. voices: a notice that starts with 'starts' may get one of 'say' in place of that start (the rest of the line kept), or one of 'whole' in place of the line, with chance (a dry line where it lands, never on every notice; Mac: professional, nothing gimmicky).

whole: That petitioner has already gone home.

voices.starts: The doors of the court close
whole: The court rises. The realm moves again.

guide._: The Hand's first-reign steps in his court card (ui.gd guide_steps, in this order: answer at court, the Hand's counsel, the banners, the tithe, a host sent); done: what he says once all are done.
steps: Follow the Hand's counsel at court
Set the royal tithe for the year
Send one of your hosts on its way
guide.done: You have the measure of the throne. The Hand will keep counsel; the choices are yours.

event_card._: The event card's words (event_card.gd, top_bar.gd show_event; bridge events.js sends riding and left). riding: the top-left line while the rider is on the road ({town}, {title}); riding_nowhere: the same with no town; riding_tip: on the answers until he arrives; ignore_now / ignore_in: before what doing nothing costs, with one season left or {n}.
event_card.riding_tip: The rider is still on the road. The King hears him out when he reaches the seat.
event_card.ignore_now: Left unanswered by the season's end:

rival._: The rival King's envoy on an event card (event_card.gd; bridge rivals.js, /world rival): from: who sent him ({king}, {realm}, {edge}); moods: his master's mood by hostility (0..100, the first whose above it clears); danger: from here the line is red.
rival.from: An envoy of {king} of {realm}, from beyond the {edge} border

moods.says: his master wants war in all but name
his master is wary of us
